mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT id FROM cache_invalidation_outbox WHERE claim_until IS NULL OR claim_until <= #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE cache_invalidation_outbox o SET claim_id = #{claimId,typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.UuidStringTypeHandler}, claim_until = #{claimUntil} FROM candidate c WHERE o.id = c.id RETURNING o.id, o.payload, o.created_at, CAST(o.claim_id AS VARCHAR) AS claim_id, o.claim_until
